title: High Over Bespin
description: High Over Bespin float two giant platforms to mine Tibanna gas from the planet below in this new illustration from THE ILLUSTRATED STAR WARS UNIVERSE (front) by Ralph McQuarrie. The original concept was a floating Imperial prison for STAR WARS, but it ended up in THE EMPIRE STRIKES BACK. "l remember drawing a lot of flying beasties," McQuarrie says. And although mechanical cloud cars were used in the film, he still prefers his elegant "flying taxis" (back).
